//: flow-epic.json — Track 2 完整编排通道（#epic / 0->1 新模块 / 跨端重构）。
//usage: node .orca/flow.mjs --config flow-epic.json "#epic <史诗需求或 0->1 模块目标>"
//switch: 切换轨道：Track 0 (--config flow-hotfix.json) | Track 1 (默认 flow.config.json / --config flow-feature.json) | Track 2 (--config flow-epic.json)
//workflow: PO Backlog & DAG 拆解 -> 契约先行(Contract Commit: API Schema/TS 类型/DB 迁移/DESIGN.md) -> 无状态并发 Worktree(仅 lint/typecheck/unit-test) -> 有状态串行集成测试 -> Visual Gate -> GPT-6.2 Sol (Xhigh) 终审 (Max Retry=2 熔断) -> 提 PR 跑 CI + Orca Decision Gate 等待人工确认合并与发布（绝不自动 Merge main）。
//autoRunNote: autoRun 设为 false 以启用终点 Orca Decision Gate（pr-ci-gate 的 gate:true）；其余步骤均设为 interactive:false 以保持自动推进，避免无谓阻塞。

//modelPool.contract-architecture (0->1 架构与契约): Gemini 4 Carbon (High, Google AI Ultra / Antigravity / Gemini CLI；禁止开 Low)。
//modelPool.po-backlog & visual-gate: Gemini 4 Neon (Medium；禁止对 Carbon/Neon 开 Low)。
//modelPool.worker-backend & worker-frontend (70% 并发: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (High, OpenCode Go；疑难 Bug 可切 Max)。
//modelPool.serial-integration (30% 复杂终端排错/集成调试): Kimi K3.1 Pro / Kimi K2.7 Code 或 GLM-5.3 (手动降为 Low/High，严禁放任 GLM-5.3 走默认 Max 卡死并发队列)。
//modelPool.senior-audit (核心安全与并发终审): GPT-6.2 Sol (Xhigh, Codex CLI；绝对不要开 Max，避免负优化与额度浪费)。
//modelPool.pr-ci-gate (PR 摘要与发布门禁): DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Low) 或 Hy4 flash / Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium)。
//modelPool.ciFallback: 远端 CI 无头审 PR 使用腾讯 TokenHub API (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 / Hy4 flash)，严禁在 CI Runner 中使用个人订阅账号。

pipeline.title: Grill Me (optional requirements interview)
pipeline.spec: You are running an optional interactive requirements interview for a Track 2 (#epic) objective. Ask ONE question at a time, prefer multiple choice, confirm all decisions explicitly, and write the finalized scope/decisions to {out}. Do NOT write code.

pipeline.title: PO Backlog & DAG Decomposition
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 2 (#epic) Product Owner & Orchestration Coordinator (Gemini 4 Neon, Medium effort — never Low). Based on {reads} and the repo, decompose the Epic into concrete Backlog/Issues and an explicit DAG dependency graph in {out}: (1) Contract-First prerequisites (API schemas, TS shared types, DB migrations, DESIGN.md); (2) stateless parallel workstreams (backend vs frontend) with strict file-ownership boundaries; (3) stateful serial integration test scenarios; (4) mechanical acceptance criteria. Do NOT write implementation code.

pipeline.title: Contract-First Architecture & Contract Commit
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 2 Chief Architect (Gemini 4 Carbon, High effort — never Low). Based on {reads}, execute CONTRACT-FIRST setup: (1) design the module boundaries, data flow, and concurrency/security invariants; (2) author/update the actual frozen contract files in the repo — API Schema (OpenAPI/RPC), shared TypeScript types, database migration files, and DESIGN.md (aligned with Google Stitch export / Open Design MCP); (3) run typecheck/schema validation and create a dedicated Contract Commit (`chore(contract): freeze schemas, types, migrations, and DESIGN.md`) on an epic/<slug> working branch (NEVER commit on main); (4) document the contract commit hash, frozen interfaces, and worker handoff rules in {out}.

pipeline.title: Parallel Worker: Backend (Stateless Checks)
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Backend Worker (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, High effort) running in a STATELESS PARALLEL group alongside worker-frontend. FIRST ACTION: maintain a live Markdown task checklist in {tasks}. Strictly obey the frozen contracts from {reads} — do NOT modify shared contracts or frontend files. STATELESS CONSTRAINT: run ONLY `lint`, `typecheck`, and `unit-test` (do NOT boot shared DBs, run live migrations, or bind shared server ports during parallel execution). If re-run after failed integration/audit, read INTEGRATION_REPORT.md and EPIC_AUDIT.md and fix all backend findings. Write {out} with changed files, unit-test results, and notes.

pipeline.title: Parallel Worker: Frontend (Stateless Checks)
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Frontend Worker (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, High effort) running in a STATELESS PARALLEL group alongside worker-backend. FIRST ACTION: maintain a live Markdown task checklist in {tasks}. Strictly obey the frozen contracts and DESIGN.md from {reads} — do NOT modify shared contracts or backend files. Implement all 4 UI states (Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error), follow anti-AI-slop rules, and reuse existing components. STATELESS CONSTRAINT: run ONLY `lint`, `typecheck`, and `unit-test` (no live DB or shared port contention). If re-run after failed visual-gate/audit, read VISUAL_GATE.md and EPIC_AUDIT.md and fix all frontend findings. Write {out} with changed files, unit-test results, and Playwright screenshot readiness.

pipeline.title: Stateful Serial Integration & DB Migration
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Stateful Serial Integration Engineer (Kimi K3.1 Pro, High effort — strong terminal debugger; if switching to GLM-5.3, set effort to Low/High and NEVER default Max). This is the SINGLE SERIAL node after parallel workers join. Based on {reads}: (1) verify all parallel changes are cleanly integrated on the local epic integration branch with no conflicts; (2) run database migrations, boot the full application services cleanly, and execute end-to-end / integration test suites; (3) capture Playwright screenshots at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile into .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ if UI exists, then tear down test services cleanly; (4) write {out} with commands, logs, and VERDICT: PASS or FAIL (outcome=failed loops back to parallel workers, maxRetries=2).

pipeline.title: Visual Gate (Playwright 1440px + 390px)
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 UI/UX Visual Gate Reviewer (Gemini 4 Neon, Medium effort — never Low). Audit Playwright 1440px desktop + 390px mobile screenshots from .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ against DESIGN.md and {reads}. Verify: Stitch/Open-Design token fidelity, restrained whitespace, crisp typography, 1px subtle borders, ZERO AI-slop purple/blue gradients or filler cards, component reuse, and 4-state completeness (Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error). If no UI exists in this Epic, state so and PASS. Write {out} with VERDICT: PASS or FAIL (outcome=failed loops back, maxRetries=2).

pipeline.title: Senior Security & Concurrency Audit (GPT-6.2 Sol Xhigh)
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 Cross-Family Senior Security & Concurrency Auditor (GPT-6.2 Sol, Xhigh effort — ABSOLUTELY NEVER Max). Perform a deep end-to-end audit of git diff, frozen contracts, concurrency safety, auth/injection/secret security, and test coverage per {reads} and AGENTS.md. Write {out} with BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR findings and VERDICT: if any BLOCKER/MAJOR exists, report FAIL (outcome=failed) — hard circuit-breaker Max Retry = 2 (exceeding 2 rounds halts for human intervention); otherwise PASS.

pipeline.title: Open PR, Verify CI & Orca Decision Gate
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 2 PR & Release Gate Coordinator. Based on {reads}: (1) verify HEAD is on the epic/<slug> branch (NEVER push directly to main and NEVER auto-merge to main); (2) push the branch (`git push -u origin HEAD`) and open/update the Pull Request targeting main (via `gh pr create` or `tea pr create`, triggering headless CI & Tencent TokenHub PR risk summary); (3) check CI status if CLI tooling is authenticated and record PR URL, CI checks, audit verdict, and rollout/rollback checklist in {out}. After this step finishes, Orca Decision Gate (`gate: true`) will pause and wait for explicit human approval before any merge or release.
